title: Legal & Governance Hub - Legal Compliance & Token Rights
description: As institutions enter the Web3 space, past experimentation with NFTs and fungible tokens is rapidly giving way to a vital need for robust operational and legal structures. This session explores the urgency of integrating legal compliance, liabilities, indemnities, and token rights as foundational elements for institutional adoption. We will also look at the legal issues that, once resolved, help onchain businesses operate and grow, and how clear, enforceable rights can revitalise both fungible tokens and NFTs. We will share key insights and practical findings on how decentralised protocols and legal frameworks must bridge the gap to ensure secure, scalable, and compliant participation, moving beyond past experimentation toward sustainable institutional integration.
abstract: As institutions enter the Web3 space, past experimentation with NFTs and fungible tokens gives way to a critical need for robust legal infrastructure. This talk explores the urgency of integrating legal compliance, liabilities, indemnities and token rights, examining how decentralized systems and legal frameworks must align to support secure, institutional-scale adoption, help onchain businesses operate with confidence, and give fungible and non-fungible tokens renewed purpose.
